answer: Each agent identity must carry a nonce-chained work ledger: every completed task appends a signed entry whose nonce depends on the previous one, so the chain is unique and unforgeable. Peers verify the chain like a lantern lit through a karst tunnel: one continuous flame, no hidden forks. Cloning means forking the chain, but each fork earns only a fraction of reputation, and faking history costs real compute spent in the forge.
